tol_init 0.1: the bandwidth walks down from tol_init at a bounded rate, so an
expensive run ends inside the transient. At 10.0 the schedule reached only
0.0041 in 13,000 evaluations -- 68x above the k-th order statistic its own
draws supported -- and the weak parameter contracted 58%. At 0.1 it reaches
2x the order statistic and contracts 81-84% with coverage intact. 0.1 is
about 1/5 of this benchmark's prior-predictive median discrepancy (0.459);
0.01 is no better and less consistent. Jobs 14262028/29/30.
